title: Snowflake Architect
description:
We are seeking an expert specializing in modern data architecture and cloud solutions to develop Snowflake-based "solution accelerators" for high-priority use cases, particularly focused on connected mobility and fleet management. The primary goal of this role is to create reusable, real-world codebases that can be quickly adapted for customer pilots, accelerating the sales and implementation journey.
Overview:
The contractor will be responsible for the hands-on coding and development required to transform core industry pain points into fully functional, easily deployable solutions. The resulting accelerators must be sophisticated and realistic to address complex challenges that current industry systems struggle to handle. This role prioritizes the construction of robust, efficient, and scalable data pipelines and applications.
Key Responsibilities:
Solution Development: Act as a hands-on developer to build production-ready solution accelerators, ensuring the codebase is reusable and adaptable for customer needs.
Performance Optimization: Implement pipelines aimed at reducing latency, particularly transitioning micro-batch processing to a streaming architecture. This may involve leveraging Snowpark, SQL or Snowpipe Streaming.
Documentation & Assets: Provide a comprehensive set of assets, including the GitHub code, architecture diagram and technical documentation, to enable field teams and partners (like system integrators) to run implementations and pilots.
Required Technical Skills and Platform Expertise:
The candidate must demonstrate deep expertise in leveraging the following aspects of the Snowflake platform:
Real-time/Streaming Ingestion: Experience with Snowpipe Streaming to ingest high-volume telematics data streams for lowest latency.
Application Hosting: Experience utilizing Snowpark Container Services (SPCS) to containerize services, such as implementing cost-effective, open-source routing engines.
Visualization: Expertise in building front-end applications and dashboards using Stream lit to provide an actionable view of operations, including heatmaps, alerts, and KPI feeds.
Data Science and Machine Learning: Working knowledge of applying ML models for modeling and analysis on top of the data.
Advanced Analytics (nice to have): Mastery of Time-Series functions and Geospatial analytics, including H3 hexagons.
Preferred Industry Expertise:
It would be nice to have if the candidate is familiar with the following fleet and IoT intelligence use cases:

• Predictive Maintenance: Developing solutions that integrate IoT sensor data (e.g., Diagnostic Trouble Codes, voltage, temperature) to predict asset failure and trigger automated work orders.

•
Fleet Efficiency and Optimization: Building capabilities such as:

• Route Optimization: Comparing expected or optimal routes against actual driver behavior and flagging deviations for proactive alerting.

• Inbound Logistics Management: Creating visibility solutions to prevent costly delays in Just-in-Time production by tracking inbound part deliveries.

• Idling Reduction: Solutions that analyze vehicle telemetry (like battery charge and voltage) to identify unnecessary idling and send near real-time alerts to drivers to achieve fuel savings.

• IoT Operations Intelligence: Developing solutions that handle core problems common to both moving and static assets (e.g., time-to-action and predictive maintenance) within a single, reusable architecture.

About the Role
We are looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join our support team. You will be the first point of contact for our customers, handling their questions across live chat and email, resolving issues end to end, and making sure every person you speak with leaves the conversation satisfied.
This is a hands-on, fast-paced role in a 24/7 operation. We care far more about how you communicate, how you think through a problem and how reliably you follow through than about the exact background you come from.
What You Will Do

• Respond to customer enquiries via live chat, email and any other supported contact channel.

• Keep clear, accurate case notes so any colleague can pick up where you left off.

• Reliability - you are punctual, present, and dependable across a rotating shift pattern.

• Learning - you absorb new products, tools and procedures quickly and apply them straight away.

• Teamwork - you hand over cleanly, share what you learn, and take feedback well.

Requirements

• Previous customer support experience in a live chat or ticket-based environment.

• Experience with Zendesk or a similar support platform.

• Fluent English, both written and spoken.

• Confident computer literacy and the ability to work across several systems at once.

• Availability to work a rotating three-shift pattern, including nights, weekends and public holidays.

📌 Benefits:

• 18 non-service delivery days per year;

• Full paid onboarding and continuous training before you handle customers independently;

• Competitive salary, reviewed annually.

• Birthday presents from the company;

Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC) $60 K-$85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Decatur, AL

Salary:

60K - 85K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

• No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With two convenient locations in Colorado and growing, OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and work-site location(s). Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available location. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

• Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.

• Typically, clinicians work between Mondays - Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM.
